name: blast-print
title: Blast Print
description: A click sends a ring that bleaches the picture, then reprints it in color inks cut from the image.

props.description: A figure that owns one Canvas. Size it with className.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. A cross-origin image needs CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin).

props.name: focus
props.description: Point of the image kept in frame when the crop fills the stage. 0 to 1, y counted from the top.

props.name: ink
props.description: Shadow tone. Any three.js color string.

props.name: paper
props.description: Light tone.

props.name: dither
props.description: Threshold pattern. Blue noise uses a 64 px tile that ships with the item.

props.name: cell
props.description: Dither cell in CSS px.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Raise it to ink more of the frame, lower it to ink less.

props.name: auraRadius
props.description: Radius multiplier of the negative aura around the pointer.

props.name: blasts
props.description: Increase it to detonate at the center of the frame from code. A click detonates at the pointer.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds one still frame and stops rendering.

props.name: label
props.default: "A picture printed as an ordered dither, bleached and reprinted in color by a click"
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Give the stage a size.
Full-frame plane without the Canvas. Mount it alone in a Canvas or a drei View. Reads state.pointer and pointer down events. The aura follows the pointer and fades after 2.5 seconds without a move.

accessibility: A figure with an accessible name. The canvas is hidden from assistive tech.
Reduced motion draws one still frame and never detonates.
Without WebGL it shows the source image in grayscale.

animation.timing: Always while visible, on demand offscreen or paused

animation.properties: Ring radius, reprint order and color mix in the fragment shader
animation.timing: 0.6 s ring, 1.1 s reprint, 0.8 s hold, 0.9 s fade
animation.trigger: Click or the blasts prop. A new blast waits until the reprint ends.

animation.reducedMotion: The aura jumps to the pointer without easing.

docs: Requires React 19 and an image your page can read as a texture. Render <BlastPrint src="/photo.jpg" className="w-full max-w-xl" /> anywhere. BlastPrint owns a Canvas, so mount BlastPrintScene inside an existing Canvas or drei View when a page already has one. The color palette is cut from the image in the browser, so the image must be readable by canvas (same origin or CORS).
